release_name: Four more coordinates (Sainte-Cecile, La Confiance, La Paix, Banneux)
notes: Continues the locality-level coordinate work. Four more sites upgraded to exact_site_approx: Sainte-Cecile (Bambous-Virieux) 0.09 km from the village centre, Notre-Dame-de-la-Confiance (Barkly) 0.24 km, Notre-Dame-de-la-Paix (Batimarais) 0.05 km and Notre-Dame-de-Banneaux (Beau-Champ) 0.28 km. Biasing each Google Maps search to the village coordinates markedly improved results: Barkly previously returned a differently-named church 15 km away and now returns Chapelle La Confiance a quarter of a kilometre from the village. Two methodological problems were found and are worth recording. First, common dedications such as Saint-Joseph and Sainte-Famille pull Google to the wrong village even with map bias, because the map centre is only a hint; those remain unresolved rather than guessed. Second, and more serious, Nominatim village geocoding for Mauritius is unreliable and has now produced a wrong gate reference three times: Beau-Champ was placed in the south-west when it is an east-coast village in Flacq, which would have wrongly rejected a match 0.28 km from the true village. Every rejection in this run was therefore re-checked against a corrected anchor before being recorded. 30 sites remain at locality level; the next pass should gate against the parent parish church coordinate, which is already well located in most cases, rather than a geocoded village name.
